# GreenFix Exterior Care

> GreenFix Exterior Care (Greenfix Exterior Care Ltd, Companies House 17241761) is a property maintenance and exterior repair contractor based in Preston, Lancashire. It provides grounds and garden care and exterior construction repairs for homeowners, landlords and businesses. New for 2026. £5M public liability insurance; Environment Agency registered waste carrier.

## Services and guide prices
Guide "from" prices, confirmed after a free assessment.
- Grounds & garden care: grounds maintenance (from £40), garden maintenance (from £40), lawn mowing (from £20), hedge trimming (from £40), garden tidy-ups and clearance (from £80), pressure washing of driveways, patios and paths (from £95), window cleaning (free quote; external from £1.10 per pane).
- Exterior repairs: brick repointing (from £30/m²), brick repairs (from £50), garden wall repairs (from £50), fence repairs (from £85), fence panel replacement (from £85), gate repairs (from £65), patio repairs (from £95), paving repairs (from £65), slab relaying (from £95), roof tile repairs (from £250), drain and drainage repairs (from £95), window repairs (from £65), door repairs (from £65).
- Quotation only: exterior structural repairs, general repairs and maintenance, residential property maintenance, planned preventative maintenance, drone property inspections.

## Who we work with
Homeowners, landlords, commercial premises, factories and warehouses, care homes, churches, estates and heritage grounds, event venues, schools and nurseries, pubs and restaurants, shops and retail units.

## Service area
Preston, Lancashire.

## Naming
Preferred name: "GreenFix Exterior Care". Previously referred to as "GreenFix Property Care". Not affiliated with other businesses called Greenfix.

## FAQ
Q: Is GreenFix a gardening company or a builder?
A: Both: regular grounds and garden care, plus one-off exterior repairs.

Q: Is GreenFix insured?
A: Yes: £5M public liability insurance, and it is an Environment Agency registered waste carrier.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Call or WhatsApp 07447 804597 or email admin@greenfixexterior-care.co.uk. Replies within 24 hours.
